host.DisableUnshareHint: Unshare attempts to isolate servers to prevent them from touching other servers, PufferPanels or the host systems files. Disabling this is a security risk unless all entities interacting with this server are fully trusted.
host.MountsHint: Grant this server access to specific files and directories on the host system without disabling Unshare completely. The server directory and necessary programs and files are always included.
